'''Qunaalac''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], or clan. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was led and represented on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] by [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]]. Being a heavily armed kajidic, the Qunaalacs retained many of the ancient [[Hutt Empire]]'s militaristic attributes, protecting most of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space's]] planets, particularly those within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' borders.
